patch.sql:
select
    c.customer_key,
    c.customer_name,
    c.market_segment,
    c.account_balance,
    n.nation_name,
    r.region_name
from {{ ref('stg_customers') }} c
join {{ ref('stg_nations') }} n on c.nation_key = n.nation_key
join {{ ref('stg_regions') }} r on n.region_key = r.region_key
patch.explanation: The unique test on dim_customers.customer_key failed with 1500 duplicate rows. stg_customers has 1500 unique keys, but dim_customers has 7500 rows, indicating duplication from joins. The original dim_customers SQL incorrectly joined stg_regions with condition `n.region_key = n.region_key`, which is always true, causing a Cartesian product with all regions. Fixing the join to `n.region_key = r.region_key` removes the duplication. After applying the patch, all tests pass.
